I have only been on this earth for a relatively short time. There have been hard choices, successes, and failures. A lot of things came easy. Some were hard.

I can't pretend to know exactly what other people have been through or what they are going through right now. But the pain running through society, the fear, it pulls at your heart. It makes you wonder where things went wrong. What a terrifying species we become when we lose faith in our ability to resolve problems, when we lose faith in each other.

Perhaps it's the politicians or the bankers, perhaps it's the right, or the left, or both. Maybe it's the racists and bigots and thugs, or maybe it's the average person's apathy. It could be the media overplaying our tragedies, selecting what "news" we hear or don't hear, and neglecting to focus on positive news, or it could be our insatiable appetite for controversy.

Regardless of the cause of today's disease of hate and disgust, there's one thing we should all agree on:

Violence is not the answer.

In fact, physical confrontation instead of calm dialogue is only bound to make matters worse. Your race, religion, personal beliefs, and political affiliation aside, we must be united for peace.

There are people who will not understand. They are angry and they are hurt, scared and defensive. Some want to fight, some feel like they are ready to kill. Some are ready to die. You may be one of those people.

But...for what?

The dead cannot shake hands, or smile, or embrace a loved one. They cannot help you with a project, play a game with you, or teach you a new skill. They cannot tell you a story, read you a rhyme, or ask you about your life. And they certainly cannot discover their faults, apologize for a mistake, or make peace with an enemy.

It's time we stood up for what is right. Regardless of what anyone says or believes, we can still stand up for peace. It almost feels weird, right? There are so many messages of hate and anger these days that it's difficult NOT to think of conflict. But it's time to change that.

Stand up for peace. Be united for peace. Peaceful dialogue, peaceful protest, even peaceful argument.

Let's leave the world in a better condition than when we found it.
